understory: Create a premium miniature botanical ground-cover asset sheet for a handcrafted stop-motion clay diorama exploration game inspired by the ancient landscapes of the Classic of Mountains and Seas. TRANSPARENT background. A 3 columns × 2 rows regular grid with six separate small objects, perfectly centered in equal size square cells; wide 3:2 canvas. No object ever crosses its cell, leave 12% transparent padding. Top left: one spreading cluster of dark green fern fronds and curled fiddleheads. Top middle: two squat gray-green layered slate boulders, fine fissures, covered with richly textured bright olive moss cushions. Top right: tall slender ochre reeds and green narrow leaves bending together from a small rooting clump, no water. Bottom left: warm sienna layered river pebbles, tiny fallen brown leaves among them. Bottom middle: cluster of five small contrasting sage and blue-green succulent rosettes with distinct pointed leaves. Bottom right: small emerald broadleaf groundcover with a curled, fallen twig and visible venation. Beautiful sculpted matte polymer clay, scores incised with modelling tool on leaves, subtle handmade impressions. Clear individual silhouettes and sculpted volume legible even at thumbnail size, natural muted greens and warm sandy accents. Same three-quarter view from above and slightly in front for all six, strong coherent soft light from top left with ambient occlusion under overlaps. Free floating transparent cut-outs. No cast shadow outside the object, no ground tile or block underneath. NO scenery, lettering, grid lines, diagrams, labels, creature, white background or decorative frames.
coast: Wide 16:9 landscape key art for a polished Chinese stop-motion clay educational game: a close miniature of Zhaoyao mountain, a little turquoise stream emptying into the west sea on the far LEFT, a narrow rustic plank footbridge, a twisting ochre trail toward a sculpted ancient mulberry-like tree with very dark trunk striations and softly luminous pale flowers on the RIGHT, a small clump of chive-like leaves with tiny blue flowers beside the winding trail, and layers of blue-green terraced Chinese mountain ridges. Tactile hand-sculpted fine polymer clay, detailed veins on leaves, hairline rock strata, clay moss, flecks in the stony trail, gorgeous handcrafted stop-motion film backdrop. Camera: a low three-quarter high angle looking diagonally through scene, intimate sense of scale. Soft warm late-afternoon light from upper left, sage, mineral jade and warm tan earth, contrasted by the dark green forest canopy. Crisp main right foreground tree, detailed middle distance, misty distant peaks. COMPOSITION: right 65% richly illustrated landscape and expressive complete tree, left 35% low-contrast pale mist/water and shoreline with space for overlaid UI text, but no flat panels. Use full bleed widescreen landscape image, no display stand or boxed diorama base, no humans or animals, no buildings, no letters, no titles, no border, no logo. All foliage, water, rocks and mountains physically handmade in clay, not an oil painting, not plastic shiny toys. Art direction sophisticated, naturalistic and suitable for ages ten and up.
